Use the CLI LLM settings and review the persisted Agent.llm configuration in agent_settings.json. The pinned CLI 1.16.0 loads SDK 1.28.1 configuration directly. File-agent model values select saved LLM profiles, rather than raw provider model IDs. Reasoning effort is model-feature dependent and omitted on the Responses subscription route; Chat extended-thinking budgets are capped below max_output_tokens. No native settings exporter is provided.
ui_steps: Press Ctrl+P to open the CLI command palette
Select Settings to configure the LLM model and credentials
